proofs.text: Run with `--gate approved` and no emails; verify the output names the approver list and `approvers` is empty. Then write a spec holding one untagged rule, run again and verify the output contains `login RULE-1` and `no risk tag`; tag that rule `[risk: high] [origin: pm]`, run again and verify `login RULE-1` is absent

rule_text: Under `approved`, init prints what the gate will otherwise fail on: the missing approver list with the command that writes it, and every rule carrying no risk tag named by feature and rule id

tests.body:
def test_no_list_prints_the_directive_the_gate_will_fail_on(self, project):
        output = project.run('--gate', 'approved')
        assert 'approver list' in output
        assert project.config()['approvers'] == []
tests.name: test_a_tagged_rule_is_not_listed
